name: Trine University
tuition_note: 2026-27 full-time undergraduate tuition ($37,750; engineering is higher at $40,850) from trine.edu/admission-aid/tuition-aid/investment-and-cost.aspx. Private university, single published rate. Room only (standard apartment/residential double at $8,000; range $7,600-$8,600 depending on style); board is separate (meal plans $5,000-$5,700).
